lines.header: FRESHNESS — this sheet must not repeat earlier sheets from the same book:
lines.angle: Where the theme allows, lean towards {angle} — not the most obvious answers.
lines.avoid: Already used on earlier sheets, do NOT repeat: {avoided}.
lines.avoidTail: Reuse one only if the theme genuinely offers nothing else that fits.
lines.nonce: Variation token {nonce} — treat this as a fresh draw and make different picks than your default ones.
